title: Refuse a non-directory .engram path during task sync setup preparation
outcome: Refuse a non-directory .engram path during task sync setup preparation
acceptance: Owned fixtures prove setup preparation refuses a regular file at .engram, including indexed or retained HEAD occupancy, without changing its bytes, index, private intent or SQLite

completion.summary:
Task-sync setup preparation now refuses a non-directory at .engram, and a .engram entry (case-insensitive) in the Git index or HEAD, before any private intent, lock or store is touched.
- Before: Windows admitted a regular .engram file, because the reserved-path probes beneath it returned NotFound, and went on to write the intent and lock. Every OS admitted an index or HEAD-only .engram entry. A .engram directory is still admitted.
- Change: src/bin_support/task_sync/setup/repository.rs +18; a new three-case test in tests/task_sync_setup_cli.rs (+35) covering a file on disk, an indexed then deleted file, and a HEAD-only file. Each case asserts the bytes or absence, an unchanged index, and no intent, lock or store home.
- Validation:
  - Vacuity 3/3.
  - Windows task_sync_setup_cli 36/36; Linux (WSL) 29/29; clippy clean on both.
  - Reviews: three clean rounds (the last Codex 12310 and Claude 12311 on the final freeze).
  - Full gate test-683b6cca 12/12 on freeze 7d0e0f46 (host verification 74b32a07).
  - Evaluation 079b2d82 passed.
  - Readiness: ready on all 4 live stores.
